class.name: FoundryBuildCommand
class.brief_description: A command requested by a script-backed Foundry build task.
class.description: Describes an external command that a [FoundryBuildTask] can return as part of a [FoundryBuildResult]. The bootstrap loader exposes this type to provider scripts so they can describe command work without executing it during provider discovery.

members.member: The command arguments, stored separately from [member executable].
Environment variables to pass to the command. Keys and values are expected to be strings.
The executable path or name to run.
The working directory for the command, usually a [code]res://[/code] project path.
